sections.content: Combine the *pretérito* *perfecto* with *porque* and por *eso* to describe an unexpected excursion. Explain what happened, why it happened, what happened as a result, and what you thought about it.

items.spanish: La excursión ha sido inesperada porque ha llovido.
items.english: The excursion has been unexpected because it has rained.

items.spanish: Ha cambiado la ruta, por eso hemos visto otro paisaje.
items.english: The route has changed, so we have seen another landscape.

items.spanish: Nos hemos mojado, por eso hemos vuelto.
items.english: We have got wet, so we have returned.
I think it has been fun.

sections.content: Use *porque* to answer 'why?' and por *eso* to show a consequence.
